title: 第170章 进入棋盘第169章 你的良心不会痛吗
content_zh:
“你是说，你在密道里踩错了砖遇到了暗箭，还有奇门遁甲阵，还被人偶攻击了？”
义老听完白月的描述后，看着眼神有些奇怪。
“啊不然呢？”白月理直气壮地跟他大眼瞪着小眼看。
“不对”，义老拿起茶杯，闻了闻，轻轻啜了一口。
“正常通关应该是先走密文砖，随后第二关会出现一面活字墙，编排好正确的顺序后就能过，第三关是一面星图，按照我给你的笔记，找到北斗星方位，就能走出，而且……”义老看了一眼白月。
“就算选错了，最多也是被机关打到在床上躺几天，不会死的。”
白月越听眉头皱得越紧，她以为密道内是对继承人综合能力的一个考验，但现在听来，好像并不是这样的。
“为什么我所通过的第二三道关卡跟你所说的并不一样？以前那些继承人呢？还有我母亲当年是怎么过的这些关卡？”白月继续追问。
“你的母亲当年就是走我所说的那条路，而且她完成得很出色，是记录中最快通过密道的人。”义老显然对当年的孔夜莺非常满意，他转头沉思了一下，对白月说道。
“以往的继承人中并没有遇到过这种过得如此吃力，甚至差点小命都交代关卡。”
“我猜，你应该是在第一关的时候就动用了真气，被机关认为是入侵者，所以启动了整个密道的防御机制，把通关难度成倍地递增了，若你不会密文，会被直接绞杀。而你又偏偏你又懂得解，所以才会出现这种不直接绞杀，但又提升难度不想让你过的局面。”
“所以我动用了真气，就会触发防御机制？为什么？继承人应该也有会古武的吧？而且你不是继承人，又是怎么进来的？”白月头顶上的问号更多了。
“哈哈哈，是些好问题，我来一个一个给你解答。”义老摸了摸他的胡子，笑着把茶杯放下了。
“首先，大多数继承人考验时年纪都比较小，就比如你现在这样，有些继承人的确在后期也会钻研家族功法修习古武，但基本上能修出点东西来都已是不惑之年，并不是所有人都有修炼的天赋。”
“其次，家主并不一定需要会古武，因为已经有暗部的存在，暗部会替家族处理所有需要武力的层面，包括监视、护卫、清理、追踪、搜集情报。而家主只需要做一件事，坐在那个位置上，掌控整个家族的方向。”
“至于为什么我可以进入，是因为我掌管着暗部的事宜，不是掌控，而是掌管，我有独有的令牌可以进出此处密室，而且，我也拥有着孔家嫡系的血脉。”
“那为什么你没有成为继承人？”白月提出了一个很关键的问题。
“为什么我没有成为继承人？“义老重复了一遍这个问题，像是在咀嚼它的重量。“其实我也想过这个问题，但这似乎不是我所能决定的。”
“嫡系会选择和培养出一个最适合的孩子作为继承人，旁支的人也会悄悄培养自己的孩子，但最终被选定的继承人只会有一个。我虽是嫡系，但我从小就不是被当做继承人候选来培养的，我的位置在暗部。”他指了指他的脚下。
“家族里的老一辈、暗部的大长老、老爷子、当年还在的几位叔祖—，他们心里都有一杆秤，谁能坐那个位置，他们都看得很准。”

他抬手指了指四壁的藏书：“我手里掌握着整个孔家暗部的运转，掌握着数百年的情报和密文档案。坐在家主位置上的那个人，要平衡各方势力、维系家族关系、处理日常事务，那些事我都做不来，也不想做，所以那个位置我让给更需要它的人去坐了。”
他顿了顿，又重新沏了壶茶，问白月：“你可知道暗部的由来？”
白月摇了摇头。
“你接触过傅心莲那小子，可能会对暗部有所耳闻，三大家族皆有暗部，但不是三大家族首创的，暗部的源头来自古武四世家里。”
听到“古武世家”这几个字，白月瞬间来了精神。
“古武世家历史悠久，他们以修炼为主，寿命也比普通人要更长一些，它们不问世事，一心追求天道，原是世人眼中的修仙者。现存一些曾入世被人知晓的家族，有四个，被成为古武四世家，以墨家为首，风家、云家、冰家紧随其后，当然可能也有一些未出世的古武家族也未得而知。”
“古武世家的嫡系一脉，均修炼正统功法，追求天道，基本不入世俗。而旁支呢？天赋不够，进不了嫡系，但又不能散出去，世间有规则，古武世家不得插足世俗之事，尤其是不能滥杀普通人。所以旁支的人大多都留在世家内部，做一些外围的事。时间久了，旁支越来越多，资源越来越紧张，矛盾也越来越大。”
“而且，旁支不单是修炼资源受限，他们只能修炼残缺的功法，血脉不纯也成为他们修炼瓶颈的一环，所以旁支想要像嫡系一样醉心修炼，难如登天。”
“然后有人想了一个办法，把一部分旁支的人放出去，让他们依附世俗中的皇族、贵族，换取资源、身份、和生存空间。作为交换，他们替那些大族做事，提供武力支持，这就是暗部的雏形。”
“三大家族都有自己的暗部，这是从古至今，世世代代的契约，以血契为证，有天道规则约束，暗部成员效忠的不是家主本人，而是家主的位置。”
白月好奇地问：“那古武四世家那边，暗部跟他们还有联系吗？”
“有，暗部的人依旧是古武世家的人，依旧可以跟古武家族来往，只不过他们身上多了一层枷锁，一层来自世俗大族的枷锁。他们是被旁支派出换取资源、身份的人，在世俗层面，他们有身份，有财富，但却不再是脱俗的修仙者。”
义老叹息了一声，继续喝了口茶，看了眼穹顶上方，有白色的飞鸟掠过，若有所思地说了一句：“看来，你触发防御机制的事，大长老那边应该也已经知道了。”
白月很快便抓住他话语中的关键。“大长老？”
义老回过神来，看向白月，大笑一声，没有回答她的问题。而是从身后取出一个精致的木盒，推给她。
“那些留给你以后去那些书里，慢慢看，慢慢了解吧。今天你的考验充满了意外与惊险，但总归你能凭借自己的能力顺利通过，而且最后的血脉考验，相信你也知道是为了验证继承人的血脉正统，你也顺利通过了考验，我很欣慰。”
义老打开了木盒，露出了里面的物品，是一枚刻有孔雀图腾的令牌。
白月摩挲着这枚令牌，它的材质不是普通的铁或铜，而是一种泛着暗光的金属，像是被反复打磨过很多年，边缘已经被磨得有些圆润了，接触到皮肤时，能感觉到一种温润的凉意。
“这是什么？”
“你是我孔家的人，虽然还没被正式承认，但你始终要回孔家，这是每个孔家候选继承人所能拥有的部分暗部权限，一个可以被调动的小队，你可以把它当保镖，当什么都可以，这是你的那部分，一个七人小队，令牌给你后，他们会自己找你的，不需要你去找他们。但令牌也有限制，不可用来做损害孔家的事，不能滥杀普通人。”义老看着白月，承认了她孔家人的身份。

“令牌是调用你那部分暗部的信物，他们只认令牌，所以你要自己保管好它。每一枚令牌都不一样，不同的层级权限的令牌，能调动的暗部范围也不一样，到你成为真正继承人的那一天，你的暗部权限，将远远不止于此。你明白了吗？”
白月点了点头，她看向自己手里的那枚玄色令牌，感觉到自己好像在慢慢进入一个比她想象中更大的棋盘，而她仅仅只是其中一颗渺小的棋子。
content_en:
"You mean, you stepped on the wrong bricks in the secret passage, encountered hidden arrows, the Qimen Dunjia Formation, and were attacked by dolls?"
After listening to Bai Yue's description, Yi Lao looked at him strangely.
"Ah, what else?" Bai Yue looked at him with big eyes and small eyes confidently.
"No." Yi Lao picked up the tea cup, smelled it, and took a sip.
"To pass a normal level, you should first go through the cipher text bricks. Then there will be a movable type wall in the second level. You can pass it after arranging the correct order. The third level is a star map. Follow the notes I gave you and find the direction of the Big Dipper. Then you can exit. And..." Yi Lao glanced at Bai Yue.
"Even if you make the wrong choice, at most you will be beaten by the agency until you have to lie in bed for a few days. You won't die."
Bai Yue's brows furrowed more and more as she listened. She thought that the secret passage was a test of the heir's comprehensive ability, but now it sounded like that was not the case.
"Why are the second and third levels I passed different from what you said? Where are the previous heirs? And how did my mother pass these levels back then?" Bai Yue continued to ask.
"Your mother took the path I mentioned back then, and she accomplished it very well. She was the fastest person in the record to pass through the secret passage." Yi Lao was obviously very satisfied with Kong Nightingale back then. He turned his head and thought for a while, and said to Bai Yue.
"None of the previous heirs have encountered such a difficult life, and even almost died in passing the test."
"I guess you must have used your true energy in the first level. You were considered an intruder by the agency, so they activated the defense mechanism of the entire secret passage and doubled the difficulty of passing the level. If you don't know the secret text, you will be strangled directly. And you know how to solve it, so there is this situation where you are not strangled directly, but the difficulty is raised to prevent you from passing."
"So when I use my true energy, the defense mechanism will be triggered? Why? There should be some heirs who know ancient martial arts, right? And if you are not the heir, how did you get in?" There were more question marks above Bai Yue's head.
"Hahaha, these are good questions. Let me answer them one by one." Yi Lao touched his beard and put down the tea cup with a smile.
"First of all, most heirs are relatively young when they are tested. Just like you now, some heirs will indeed delve into family skills and practice ancient martial arts in the later stages, but they are basically in their forties before they can practice anything. Not everyone has the talent to practice."
"Secondly, the head of the family does not necessarily need to know ancient martial arts, because there is already an ANBU, and the ANBU will handle all aspects that require force for the family, including monitoring, guarding, cleaning, tracking, and collecting intelligence. The head of the family only needs to do one thing, sit in that position and control the direction of the entire family."
"As for why I can enter, it's because I am in charge of the affairs of the ANBU, not in charge, but in charge. I have a unique token to enter and exit the secret room here. Moreover, I also have the blood of the direct line of the Kong family."
"Then why didn't you become the heir?" Bai Yue asked a very crucial question.
"Why didn't I become the heir?" Yi Lao repeated the question as if chewing its weight. "Actually, I have also thought about this issue, but it seems that it is not something I can decide."
"The direct line will select and train the most suitable child as the heir, and people from the side branches will also secretly train their own children, but in the end there will only be one chosen heir. Although I am a direct line, I have not been trained as a successor candidate since I was a child. My position is in the Anbu." He pointed at his feet.
"The older generation in the family, the elders of the Anbu, the old man, and the uncles who were still there at that time - they all have a steelyard in their hearts, and they all know who can sit in that position."
He raised his finger and pointed at the collection of books on the four walls: "I hold in my hands the fate of the entire Kong family's dark department.Turn, mastering hundreds of years of intelligence and cipher text files. The person sitting in the position of the head of the family has to balance the forces of all parties, maintain family relationships, and handle daily affairs. I can't do those things, and I don't want to do them, so I gave that position to someone who needs it more. "
He paused, made another pot of tea, and asked Bai Yue: "Do you know the origin of ANBU? "
Bai Yue shook her head.
"If you have been in contact with Fu Xinlian, you may have heard about ANBU. All three major families have ANBU, but they are not the first ones. The source of ANBU comes from the family of Kotake IV. "
Hearing the words "Guwu Family", Bai Yue instantly became energetic.
"The Guwu family has a long history. They mainly focus on cultivation, and their lifespans are longer than ordinary people. They don't care about worldly affairs and pursue the way of heaven. They were originally cultivators in the eyes of the world. There are four existing families that are known to have been in the world, and they are known as the Four Guwu Families, headed by the Mo family, followed by the Feng family, the Yun family, and the Bing family. Of course, there may also be some unborn Guwu families that are unknown. "
"The direct descendants of the ancient martial arts family all practice orthodox martial arts, pursue the way of heaven, and basically do not follow the secular world. What about the side branches? The talent is not enough to enter the direct lineage, but it cannot be spread out. There are rules in the world. The ancient martial arts family must not interfere in worldly affairs, especially they cannot kill ordinary people indiscriminately. Therefore, most of the people from the side branch stayed within the family and did some peripheral things. As time goes by, there are more and more side branches, resources are getting tighter, and conflicts are getting bigger and bigger. "
"Moreover, not only are the training resources of the side branches limited, they can only practice incomplete techniques, and their impure bloodline has also become a bottleneck in their cultivation. Therefore, it is difficult for the side branches to practice as enthusiastically as the direct lineage. "
"Then someone thought of a way to release some of the people from the side branches and let them attach themselves to the royal family and nobles in the world in exchange for resources, status, and living space. In exchange, they worked for those wealthy families and provided military support. This was the prototype of ANBU. "
"The three major families all have their own ANBU. This is a contract that has been made for generations since ancient times. It is evidenced by the blood contract and bound by the rules of heaven. The members of the ANBU are loyal not to the family leader himself, but to the position of the family leader. "
Bai Yue asked curiously: "As for the Fourth Kowu Family, do the ANBU still have contact with them? "
"Yes, the ANBU people are still members of the Furuwu family, and can still associate with the Furuwu family, but they have an extra layer of shackles on them, a layer of shackles from the secular family. They are people sent by side branches in exchange for resources and status. On a secular level, they have status and wealth, but they are no longer worldly immortal cultivators. "
Yi Lao sighed, continued to drink tea, glanced at the white birds flying above the dome, and said thoughtfully: "It seems that the Great Elder should also know that you triggered the defense mechanism. "
Bai Yue quickly grasped the key to his words. "Great Elder? "
Yi Lao came back to his senses, looked at Bai Yue, laughed, and did not answer her question. Instead, he took out an exquisite wooden box from behind and pushed it to her.
"I'll leave those for you to go into those books later, read them slowly, and understand them slowly. Your test today was full of surprises and thrills, but in the end you were able to pass it smoothly with your own abilities. I believe you also know that the final bloodline test was to verify the legitimacy of the heir's bloodline. I am very pleased that you also passed the test smoothly. "
Yi Lao opened the wooden box and revealed the item inside, which was a token engraved with a peacock totem.
Bai Yue rubbed the token. Its material was not ordinary iron or copper, but a metal with a dark light. It seemed that it had been polished repeatedly for many years, and the edges had been rounded. When it came into contact with the skin, one could feel a warm and cool feeling.
"What is this? "
"You are a member of my Kong family, although you haven't yetYou are officially recognized, but you always have to return to the Kong family. This is part of the ANBU authority that each candidate heir to the Kong family can have. It is a team that can be mobilized. You can use it as a bodyguard or anything. This is your part, a seven-person team. After the token is given to you, they will find you on their own, and you do not need to find them. But the token also has restrictions. It cannot be used to harm the Kong family, and it cannot be used to kill ordinary people indiscriminately. " Yi Lao looked at Bai Yue and admitted her identity as a member of the Kong family.
"The token is a token to call the ANBU part of you. They only recognize the token, so you have to keep it safe. Every token is different, and tokens with different levels of authority have different ranges of ANBU that can be mobilized. On the day you become the true heir, your ANBU authority will be far more than that. Do you understand? "
Bai Yue nodded. She looked at the black token in her hand and felt as if she was slowly entering a bigger chessboard than she imagined, and she was just a tiny chess piece in it.
